title: Whose voice narrates the Dev Day demo video?
body: The 3:30 script is on the Demo tab (9 beats, about 420 words). I'm cutting the rough cut with a scratch Mac voice for timing only; the final voice drops in per beat whatever you pick. My pick is (c): it's your own voice, needs none of your time before tonight's 23:59 UTC deadline, and costs about 2,600 of the 130,000 characters left this month. Choose (a) if you'd rather record it: read each beat into your phone and send me the files by about 19:00 UTC. For (b), the stock voice would be ElevenLabs 'Evan – Calm, Grounded'.

options.label: I record the voice-over myself from the script
